scope: Analytical bounds from stated datasheet values; not a simulation or measurement

latch.note: TPS22917 slew figures are typical only; the press-duration bound is an allowance, not a guarantee.

inrush.note: X5R/X7R DC-bias derating lowers effective C; measure inrush at first article.

off_current.note: Everything downstream of U7 (regulator, dividers, MCU, FRAM, OLED) is unpowered when off.

battery_adc.note: STAT1/STAT2 low also classify USB, covering the charging and fault states at any ADC error.

cold_insertion.latch_effect: U7 is OFF at insertion (no key, no USB), so SYS_LOAD capacitance never loads the cell at insertion; the upstream C2/C3 counterexample of Q4 is unchanged.
cold_insertion.bq2970_first_connection: SLUSBU9I 8.4.1: discharge may not enable until a charger is connected - insert the cell with USB present.

storage.recommendation: Store charged to about 50-60 %, top up every 3 months; after the 3.35 V firmware cut-off the protector disconnects at 2.8 V roughly a week later.

retained_counterexample: Unrestricted cold insertion (upstream C2+C3) still exceeds the 125 us minimum SCC delay.
